o Had the distinct privilege of forging collaborative partnerships with an array of Fortune 500 enterprises,
spanning diverse industries such as Product Technology, paints, and Lifestyle brands. My specialisation
lies in the dynamic domains E-commerce and Marketing. My role has been pivotal in the systematic
gathering of requirements & fostering productive client interactions & proactively driving project success

unwavering in upholding rigorous Quality Assurance standards for each project
o Acted as a Subject-Matter Expert  for four substantial projects from Fortune 500  clients, regularly
conducting impactful product demonstrations to clients fostering relationships built on trust & expertise

Sprint stand-up meetings in my capacity as Scrum Master. Served as a skilled facilitator for the Scrum team
ensuring optimal collaboration and productivity

central role in fostering a culture of continuous improvement for the team
